title: aprender KMeans has no n_init restarts: vs sklearn KMeans(n_init=10) inertia is worse at 28/29 k and ARI at the chosen k=12 is 0.24
evidence: E9 parity run 2026-09-25 on 232 unclaimed-issue docs (232x2665; earlier text said 191, wrong) (TF-IDF, seed 42, max_iter 300, tol 1e-4). TfidfVectorizer: same vocab set, max |dX| 5.0e-10, so the input is identical. KMeans inertia k=2..30: aprender > sklearn n_init=10 at 28/29 k (max +1.76%, k=12 +1.29%); aprender < sklearn n_init=1 at 15/29, i.e. single-init parity, not an update-step defect. ARI(ap, sk_n10) at k=12 = 0.238, and sklearn's own n_init=1 vs n_init=10 ARI = 0.260. crates/aprender-core/src/cluster/kmeans_impl.rs exposes with_max_iter/with_tol/with_random_state only. Artifacts /mnt/nvme-raid0/tmp/5d-clusters/e9/compare.json + crates/aprender-core/examples/e9_unclaimed_kmeans.rs (worktree aprender-wt-5d-e9, uncommitted).
repro: Fit KMeans::new(k).with_random_state(42) and sklearn KMeans(n_clusters=k, random_state=42, n_init=10) on the same dense TF-IDF matrix for k in 2..30 and compare inertia_ and adjusted_rand_score. Fix direction: add with_n_init(n) (best-of-n by inertia, default 1 to preserve outputs) + a parity test vs a pinned sklearn fixture.
suspected_epic: none (aprender-core cluster; sklearn-parity) - cop to route
resolution: KMeans::with_n_init (default 1, seeded best-of-inertia, strict-improvement). E9 29-k falsifier: n_init=10 beats 1 at 21/29 k, worse at 0/29. vs sklearn n_init=10: max gap +1.76%->+1.35%, mean +0.93%->+0.58%. Residual gap = deterministic farthest-point seeding vs D2 k-means++ sampling (row 5d-E9-kmeans-d2-seeding). DEFAULT: 1 (sklearn>=1.4 n_init="auto" for k-means++-family seeding), per cop aprender-77 2026-09-25 superseding the earlier "default 10" (#3146 is the epic and names no n_init). A default KMeans::new(k) fit is unchanged from before n_init; with_n_init(10) gives the E9 21/29-K improvement. Old saved models load as n_init=1 (7e129599b). SCOPE (#3146 = Pareto gap-closure vs linfa 0.8.1): linfa-clustering 0.8.1 KMeans has n_runs, best-of-inertia over runs, default 10 (src/k_means/hyperparams.rs:21,60-75, init KMeansPlusPlus) — aprender had no equivalent; with_n_init closes that linfa gap. Default kept at 1 per cop (sklearn>=1.4 "auto"), NOT linfa's 10.

evidence: After n_init=10 (d868ec946), aprender inertia is still above sklearn at 25/29 k on the E9 232x2665 corpus (max +1.35% at k=12: 190.597 vs 188.169, unchanged by n_init).
